source_spans.title: Choose the report for the question
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Reports brings several questions together: who is currently staffed, what happened on calls, and which timestamps have been recorded. In our fictional Chicago Fire department, begin with the Reporting catalog. Find Staffing Report and use its View Report button.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries; zero is proposed static opening pre-roll only.

source_spans.title: Choose the report for the question
source_spans.exact_narration_span: The report groups people by their latest recorded staffing level and provides a count and chart. Truck 81 has people in Available, Unavailable and On Shift categories. This is a staffing summary; it does not establish who physically attended an incident.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Read the member-level staffing evidence
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Below the summary, read Name, Group, Roles, Staffing and Staffing Timestamp together. Next Change and Next Staffing describe a scheduled change when one exists. A blank cell supplies no future staffing commitment. Wallace Boden’s row also carries an explicit training note.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Read the member-level staffing evidence
required_labels: Officer, TRAINING ONLY - Community response navigator
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Farther down, Matthew Casey’s row shows Truck 81, Officer and the training Community Response Navigator role, with On Shift staffing. The report reads existing personnel information; running it does not edit those memberships or statuses.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Define a Call Summary period
source_spans.exact_narration_span: On the Call Summary Report parameter page, check Report Start Time, Report End Time and Group before using Run Report. This example starts October twenty-fifth, twenty twenty-six, at midnight and ends October twenty-ninth at twenty-three thirty. All Groups is selected. These are department-local report boundaries. Read the complete values before running: a different start, end or group changes the population being summarized.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Check totals against types and states
source_spans.exact_narration_span: The resulting header repeats the selected period. This captured run contains fifteen calls, with four open, nine unit responses and four personnel responses. Response totals accumulate across calls; they are not a count of unique department members or vehicles.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Check totals against types and states
source_spans.exact_narration_span: The tables provide a useful cross-check. Investigation, Structure Fire, Rescue and Medical counts total fifteen. Call States separates eleven Closed from four Active. Read the table labels and denominators before comparing percentages with another report.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Understand how calls are assigned to groups
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Calls by Group explains why a call belongs to a reporting group. Each call counts once. A containing group geofence is used first; otherwise the report uses the group associated with most dispatched resources. Some calls can remain unassigned. This is different from simply listing the current viewer’s group. Here, Firehouse 51 has seven calls and Command has five. Use the explanation when investigating a surprising group total instead of changing memberships to make a report match expectations.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Read the individual call rows
source_spans.exact_narration_span: The Calls table lets you inspect the rows behind the summary. Read Number, Name, Type, Group, Logged On, Closed On and the duration columns. The original three DEMO calls are still Open in this result, and their OnScene Time is N/A.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Read the individual call rows
required_labels: TRAINING ONLY - Native Unit response and deselection
source_spans.exact_narration_span: The lower rows include the native Unit response and deselection exercise, number ending zero zero zero eight, also Open at this report’s generation. N/A is missing usable timing information, not a zero-minute arrival. Preserve that distinction when explaining averages.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Set the Call Unit Times window
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Call Unit Times answers a more specific question: which dispatch and status timestamps exist for each unit on each call? Its parameter form has start and end times and Run Report. Here the range starts October twenty-fourth at twenty-three thirty and ends October twenty-ninth at twenty-three thirty. That begins thirty minutes earlier than our first Call Summary. Keep those periods distinct when reconciling the results.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Interpret timestamps and their linkage
source_spans.exact_narration_span: The generated report has Dispatched, En Route, On Scene, Staging, Cleared and Linked By columns. The original DEMO rows say Dispatch only and leave later status times blank. A dispatch entry alone does not establish an arrival.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Interpret timestamps and their linkage
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Other exercise rows say Unit status. Read the recorded timestamps as they stand; some are incomplete or out of order, so review the underlying history before calculating a duration.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Interpret timestamps and their linkage
required_labels: No unit was dispatched to this call or reported a status on it.
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Some calls explicitly report no unit dispatch or status data. The native exercise shows Ambulance 61 with dispatch and en-route times, while its later cells remain blank. These are software records, not independent physical-arrival verification.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Download and interpret the real CSV
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Use Download CSV on this report to obtain its unit rows for the same parameters. The downloaded file includes call and unit identifiers, timestamps and Linked By. This exercise export contains thirteen unit rows for twelve distinct calls: a call with two units creates two rows, while a call with no unit rows contributes none. The file uses DispatchOnly and Explicit codes where the screen says Dispatch only and Unit status. Keep blank times blank, and retain the report period with your file.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Run an explicit group scope
source_spans.exact_narration_span: For a separate comparison, the parameters now show the default period spanning late December twenty twenty-five to late December twenty twenty-six. This is not the earlier October week. Select Command in Group and use Run Report.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.

required_labels: Group: Command (including the groups beneath it)

source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.title: Run an explicit group scope
source_spans.exact_narration_span: Its detail table shows those five exercise rows with Command dispatch attribution. A group filter narrows the report; it does not move resources, reassign calls or close them.
source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.

source_spans.timing_basis: Unchanged actual generated SRT cue boundaries.
